opening.argument: The presentation actively solicits participation by pairing a binary compensation structure with extraordinary income and growth claims. It describes “one points plan as a binary with a four-generation matching bonus” and asserts that “more than 285 Oncoin members have maxed out the compensation plan at almost $40,000 per week,” presenting substantial commissions as an attainable result of the plan. The speaker then directly urges viewers, “Partner with us and watch your business explode,” linking the opportunity to partnership and leadership growth. Finally, the claim that “OneCoin has already increased from 1 penny to over $1.40 in 8 months” reinforces that recruitment appeal with rapid token appreciation and promised wealth potential.
